column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 24 (M23024): konvoi pasokan Kalina dicegat Nyto militer.
# Tetap Inggris: Kalina/Kalin, Robella, Leva, Lenna, Griffin, Nyto/Nytos, Paradeus,
# Mokosh, Yellow Zone, Neo-Soviet Union, Doll, IFF.

(Outside the Yellow Zone front line, a small Doll team carrying tactical supplies was carefully avoiding the frontal troops deployed by the military, trying to cross the fiercely fought line of fire.)
column2: (Di luar garis depan Yellow Zone, sebuah tim Doll kecil yang membawa perbekalan taktis dengan hati-hati menghindari pasukan garis depan yang digelar militer, berusaha menembus garis tembak yang diperebutkan sengit.)

column1: (They did not wear obvious unit designations, and even their march was conducted in a concealed state as much as possible. However, such a sizable supply team was still difficult to avoid the enemy's search.)
column2: (Mereka tidak mengenakan tanda satuan yang mencolok, dan bahkan perjalanannya pun ditempuh sesembunyi mungkin. Namun tim pasokan sebesar itu tetap sulit lolos dari penyisiran musuh.)

column1: (Unless—)
column2: (Kecuali—)

column1: Kalin, we must pass through here as soon as possible.
column2: Kalin, kita harus melewati tempat ini secepatnya.

column1: Although we are currently the military's supply unit on the radar, I can only interfere with the military's IFF system for a short time.
column2: Meski di radar kita sekarang tampak sebagai unit pasokan militer, aku cuma bisa mengganggu sistem IFF militer dalam waktu singkat.

column1: An hour later, the military's network nodes will reset, and our location information will also be exposed...
column2: Sejam lagi, simpul jaringan militer akan direset, dan informasi lokasi kita pun akan terbongkar...

column1: Very well, I understand.
column2: Baiklah, aku mengerti.

column1: Leva... and Lenna, thank you for your hard work.
column2: Leva... dan Lenna, terima kasih atas kerja keras kalian.

column1: Nothing~
column2: Bukan apa-apa~

column1: I'm so glad I could help Kalina, hehe~♪
column2: Senangnya bisa membantu Kalina, hehe~♪

column1: I really want to help too!
column2: Aku juga ingin sekali membantu!

column1: Kalina, is there any fight I can pick on this road?
column2: Kalina, ada perkelahian yang bisa kucari di sepanjang jalan ini?

column1: Shhh—
column2: Sst—

column1: Leva and Lenna finally managed to hide our tracks to ensure that these supplies in our hands can be delivered in place.
column2: Leva dan Lenna susah payah menyembunyikan jejak kita supaya perbekalan di tangan kita ini bisa sampai ke tujuan.

column1: If you want to fight, there will be quite a battle to fight when we get to the Commander later.
column2: Kalau kau mau bertarung, nanti setelah sampai ke tempat Komandan akan ada pertempuran yang cukup seru.

column1: I'm just a little bored! Guarding so much heavy firepower ammunition with nowhere to use it... Forget it, forget it. When I see the Commander later, I have to put on a good performance!
column2: Aku cuma agak bosan! Menjaga amunisi daya tembak berat sebanyak ini tanpa bisa dipakai... Sudahlah, sudahlah. Nanti kalau bertemu Komandan, aku harus tampil bagus!

column1: That's of secondary importance...
column2: Itu urusan nomor dua...

column1: Right now, I only hope to deliver these things safely into the Commander's hands... What happens after that is out of our control.
column2: Sekarang aku cuma berharap barang-barang ini sampai dengan selamat ke tangan Komandan... Apa yang terjadi setelah itu bukan lagi kendali kita.

column1: (A deep crease forms between Kalina's brows. Beside her, the past Griffin Dolls also fall silent.)
column2: (Kerutan dalam terbentuk di antara alis Kalina. Di sebelahnya, para Doll Griffin dari masa lalu pun terdiam.)

column1: This is the first time I've seen Kalin so worried...
column2: Ini pertama kalinya aku melihat Kalin secemas ini...

column1: Should we give the Commander a call to check in?
column2: Perlukah kita menghubungi Komandan untuk memastikan keadaannya?

column1: Mokosh's signal has been completely disconnected. The military must have cut off their subsequent supplies long ago.
column2: Sinyal Mokosh sudah terputus sepenuhnya. Militer pasti sudah lama memutus pasokan lanjutan mereka.

column1: Oh, those old foxes~ All these methods previously used against the Neo-Soviet Union army are now being used on the Commander.
column2: Aduh, rubah-rubah tua itu~ Semua cara yang dulu dipakai melawan tentara Neo-Soviet Union sekarang dipakai pada Komandan.

column1: Yeah. So if we can't arrive in time, the Commander and the others will be in trouble...
column2: Iya. Jadi kalau kita tidak sampai tepat waktu, Komandan dan yang lain akan celaka...

column1: (At this point, Kalina suddenly feels the carrier vehicle's speed rapidly increase.)
column2: (Saat itu, Kalina tiba-tiba merasakan kecepatan kendaraan angkut itu melonjak cepat.)

column1: Although doing this might consume the fuel for the return trip... until the predicament on the Commander's end is resolved, everyone probably hasn't thought about leaving first, right?
column2: Meski melakukan ini mungkin menghabiskan bahan bakar untuk perjalanan pulang... sampai kesulitan di pihak Komandan selesai, sepertinya tak seorang pun berpikir untuk pergi duluan, kan?

column1: Of course! I'm looking forward to having a thrilling battle when we get there!
column2: Tentu saja! Aku menantikan pertempuran seru begitu kita sampai!

column1: I heard the military deployed a lot of incredibly powerful new equipment this time, I'm so excited to observe them up close, hehe~!
column2: Kudengar militer mengerahkan banyak perlengkapan baru yang luar biasa kuat kali ini, aku tidak sabar mengamatinya dari dekat, hehe~!

column1: (The group thus approached Mokosh's front line at the fastest speed on the route.)
column2: (Rombongan itu pun mendekati garis depan Mokosh dengan kecepatan tertinggi di sepanjang rute.)

column1: (However...)
column2: (Namun...)

column1: Robella, we should be almost there, right?
column2: Robella, kita sudah hampir sampai, kan?

column1: (About an hour later, guided by radar and the Dolls' built-in databases, the supply team led by Kalina had quietly slipped into the jurisdiction near Mokosh.)
column2: (Sekitar sejam kemudian, dipandu radar dan basis data bawaan para Doll, tim pasokan pimpinan Kalina sudah diam-diam menyusup ke wilayah dekat Mokosh.)

column1: Mhm, about 20 kilometers left. At our current speed, we should reach the outermost battlefield in about an hour.
column2: Mhm, tersisa sekitar 20 kilometer. Dengan kecepatan sekarang, kita seharusnya mencapai medan tempur terluar dalam kira-kira sejam.

column1: However...
column2: Tapi...

column1: (Robella looked seriously at the static on the vehicle's radar.)
column2: (Robella menatap serius statis di radar kendaraan itu.)

column1: (A few minutes ago, the signal on the radar was getting weaker, and now the display is completely unreadable.)
column2: (Beberapa menit lalu, sinyal di radar itu makin melemah, dan sekarang layarnya sama sekali tidak terbaca.)

column1: We've probably entered an area where the military has implemented electronic jamming... For the rest of the way, we'll just have to rely on offline maps.
column2: Kita mungkin sudah masuk ke area tempat militer memasang gangguan elektronik... Untuk sisa perjalanan, kita terpaksa mengandalkan peta luring.

column1: But in this kind of non-primary Yellow Zone, the accuracy of offline maps is not high, and we are getting closer and closer to the frontal battlefield now...
column2: Tapi di Yellow Zone yang bukan kawasan utama seperti ini, akurasi peta luring tidak tinggi, dan sekarang kita makin dekat ke medan tempur garis depan...

column1: Kalina, I'm afraid the next matter requires you, the only human present, to make a decision.
column2: Kalina, sepertinya urusan berikutnya butuh keputusan darimu, satu-satunya manusia di sini.

column1: It's fine for us Dolls, but if by any chance we get lost in the Yellow Zone, or some other accident happens... I'm very worried that you, as a human, wouldn't be able to bear such severe consequences.
column2: Bagi kami para Doll tidak masalah, tapi kalau kita sampai tersesat di Yellow Zone, atau terjadi kecelakaan lain... aku sangat khawatir kau sebagai manusia tidak akan sanggup menanggung akibat seberat itu.

column1: It's okay... don't worry about me.
column2: Tidak apa-apa... jangan cemaskan aku.

column1: Compared to this, the Commander's side is more worth worrying about.
column2: Dibanding ini, keadaan di pihak Komandan lebih pantas dicemaskan.

column1: More than ten hours have passed since the military surrounded Mokosh. If we don't deliver the supplies quickly—
column2: Sudah lebih dari sepuluh jam sejak militer mengepung Mokosh. Kalau kita tidak cepat mengantar pasokannya—

column1: Wait.
column2: Tunggu.

column1: Robella—stop the car quickly!
column2: Robella—cepat hentikan mobilnya!

column1: What?!
column2: Apa?!

column1: (Hearing Leva's warning, Robella immediately slammed on the brakes, almost throwing everyone out of the car.)
column2: (Mendengar peringatan Leva, Robella langsung menginjak rem dalam-dalam, nyaris melempar semua orang keluar dari mobil.)

column1: Uwaahhhhh—so thrilling!!
column2: Uwaahhhhh—seru sekali!!

column1: (The huge inertia of the car made the wheels' trajectory drift into a huge "Z" shape.)
column2: (Inersia besar mobil itu membuat lintasan rodanya menggores bentuk "Z" raksasa.)

column1: Cough—cough cough cough—
column2: Uhuk—uhuk uhuk uhuk—

column1: Big Sis Kalin, are you okay?
column2: Kak Kalin, kau tidak apa-apa?

column1: Sorry...!
column2: Maaf...!

column1: Leva, what just happened?
column2: Leva, apa yang barusan terjadi?

column1: It seems we've... encountered an incredible enemy.
column2: Sepertinya kita... berpapasan dengan musuh yang luar biasa.

column1: (About two kilometers away from the supply vehicle, the originally calm desert visibly began to surge... Immediately after, wave-like patterns spread across the sand, getting closer and closer to the supply unit led by Kalina.)
column2: (Sekitar dua kilometer dari kendaraan pasokan itu, gurun yang semula tenang mulai bergolak kentara... Tak lama kemudian, pola-pola bak gelombang menyebar di atas pasir, makin dekat ke unit pasokan pimpinan Kalina.)

column1: (In the next instant, several swift-moving "Dolls" surged out from the sand—)
column2: (Sesaat kemudian, beberapa "Doll" yang bergerak gesit menyembur keluar dari pasir—)

column1: Oh no! Big Sis Kalina, those look like... enemy Dolls!
column2: Gawat! Kak Kalina, itu kelihatannya... Doll musuh!

column1: Dolls...
column2: Doll...

column1: No... they are...
column2: Bukan... mereka itu...

column1: Nytos.
column2: Nyto.

column1: Nytos?! But... why would there be Nytos here...
column2: Nyto?! Tapi... kenapa ada Nyto di sini...

column1: And... those markings belong to the military, right? The military acting together with Nytos?
column2: Dan... tanda-tanda itu milik militer, kan? Militer bergerak bersama Nyto?

column1: Hmph... the cooperation between those old foxes and Paradeus is much closer than we imagined.
column2: Hmph... kerja sama rubah-rubah tua itu dengan Paradeus jauh lebih erat dari bayangan kita.

column1: Just to deal with an ordinary supply unit, even Nytos have been deployed.
column2: Cuma untuk menghadapi unit pasokan biasa, sampai Nyto pun dikerahkan.

column1: Or is it... an accidental encounter?
column2: Atau ini... papasan yang tidak disengaja?

column1: And I guess, these guys in front of us shouldn't be all of them, right?
column2: Dan kurasa, yang di depan kita ini belum semuanya, kan?

column1: (As if confirming Leva's words, billowing dust immediately rose behind several Dolls. A fully equipped mechanized armed force's armored vehicles were hidden amidst the sand and dust, advancing in an orderly manner along with the pace of the mechs.)
column2: (Seakan membenarkan ucapan Leva, debu langsung mengepul tebal di belakang beberapa Doll itu. Kendaraan lapis baja pasukan bersenjata mekanis yang lengkap tersembunyi di balik pasir dan debu, maju tertib mengikuti langkah para mech.)

column1: Damn it... they can't be seen on the radar at all... the enemy has already discovered us.
column2: Sialan... mereka sama sekali tidak terlihat di radar... musuh sudah menemukan kita.

column1: The military has deployed quite powerful electronic countermeasures this time. Civilian Dolls like us absolutely cannot detect them.
column2: Militer mengerahkan penangkal elektronik yang cukup kuat kali ini. Doll sipil seperti kita sama sekali tidak bisa mendeteksinya.

column1: It seems these people are really wary of the Commander's team. Hehe... they won't even let a small-scale supply unit like us pass?
column2: Sepertinya orang-orang ini benar-benar waspada pada tim Komandan. Hehe... unit pasokan sekecil kita pun tidak dibiarkan lewat?

column1: I knew there would definitely be a chance for me to shine!
column2: Sudah kuduga pasti ada kesempatan untukku bersinar!

column1: How about it, Kalina, should we fight? Our firepower right now is quite sufficient!
column2: Bagaimana, Kalina, kita bertempur saja? Daya tembak kita sekarang cukup memadai!

column1: ...No, try not to encounter them head-on.
column2: ...Tidak, usahakan jangan berhadapan langsung dengan mereka.

column1: Our goal this time is to deliver the armaments to the Commander. Engaging with enemy forces is not a necessary action for us.
column2: Tujuan kita kali ini mengantar persenjataan ke Komandan. Bertempur dengan pasukan musuh bukan tindakan yang perlu bagi kita.

column1: Understood.
column2: Dimengerti.

column1: Kalina, you follow the convoy to the rear to take shelter first, we will organize a blocking operation against the enemy.
column2: Kalina, kau ikut konvoi ke belakang untuk berlindung dulu, kami akan menyusun operasi penghadangan terhadap musuh.

column1: Once we make sure there are no pursuers, we'll catch up with you.
column2: Begitu kami pastikan tidak ada pengejar, kami akan menyusul kalian.

column1: But you guys...
column2: Tapi kalian...

column1: I know what you're worried about, Kalin.
column2: Aku tahu apa yang kaucemaskan, Kalin.

column1: But don't forget, we have Robella, the first true third-generation Doll, here.
column2: Tapi jangan lupa, kita punya Robella, Doll generasi ketiga sejati yang pertama, di sini.

column1: Putting our lives in the hands of someone like this, we can be somewhat at ease, right?
column2: Menyerahkan nyawa kita ke tangan orang seperti itu, kita bisa cukup tenang, kan?

column1: Hey... don't say it so reluctantly.
column2: Hei... jangan mengatakannya seolah terpaksa begitu.

column1: Haven't we cooperated like this several times before?
column2: Bukankah kita sudah beberapa kali bekerja sama seperti ini?

column1: For Sister Leva, being able to say such words is already considered the highest level of trust!
column2: Bagi Kak Leva, bisa mengucapkan kata-kata seperti itu sudah terhitung tingkat kepercayaan tertinggi!

column1: Alright... then we'll arrange it like this for now.
column2: Baiklah... kalau begitu untuk sekarang kita atur begini.

column1: Robella, the command of the battlefield here is handed over to you.
column2: Robella, komando medan tempur di sini kuserahkan padamu.

column1: No accidents are allowed... If you encounter a special situation, find a way to retreat immediately.
column2: Tidak boleh ada kecelakaan... Kalau menemui situasi khusus, segera cari cara untuk mundur.

column1: Make sure you come back safely and reunite with everyone.
column2: Pastikan kalian kembali dengan selamat dan berkumpul lagi dengan semuanya.

column1: Mm, I promise you.
column2: Mm, aku berjanji padamu.

column1: (Watching Kalina and the supply truck drive away, Robella turned around.)
column2: (Menatap Kalina dan truk pasokan itu menjauh, Robella berbalik.)

column1: Alright, everyone.
column2: Baiklah, semuanya.

column1: The combat objective is to intercept the enemy's ambush troops and disrupt their search system.
column2: Sasaran tempurnya adalah mencegat pasukan penyergap musuh dan mengacaukan sistem penyisiran mereka.

column1: At least... hold on until Kalina and the others transfer to a safe place.
column2: Setidaknya... bertahan sampai Kalina dan yang lain berpindah ke tempat aman.

column1: Can't fight with full strength? What a pity!
column2: Tidak boleh bertarung habis-habisan? Sayang sekali!

column1: But... I'll play with you big fools for a bit, hehe~
column2: Tapi... aku akan bermain sebentar dengan kalian, dasar bodoh, hehe~
